$Comment: A phase transition on the boss's health, with the beat the library listens for. Reference it
inside a state's Instructions with _ExportStates naming the state to move to, and set Signal to
zc:phase:<that state> so the library records the phase, reconciles the health scale and fires
HealthRange is the boss's health as a fraction of its maximum, so [0, 0.5] fires at half. Set
SwapRole true and Role to a role id to change the boss's role in place at the transition (the
engine keeps its aggro, its target slot and its uuid across the swap); leave SwapRole false to

Slot.Description: The target slot holding the boss.

Range.Description: How far the boss may be from the encounter entity to be sensed.

HealthRange.Description: Fire when the boss's health over its maximum falls inside this range.

Signal.Description: The beat sent as the phase changes: zc:phase: followed by the state Next points at.

SwapRole.Description: Whether to change the boss's role in place at the transition.

Role.Description: The role to change the boss to when SwapRole is true.
